intro.text: Ah, {name}! You've grown restless, I can tell. Beyond our fences lies a whole island nobody in Brightvale has explored in a generation.

ask.text: They say the old star left treasures scattered across the land when it fell. Will you go and see for yourself?

choices.reason: Boasted to Elder Bram that nothing scares you

choices.text: I'm a little scared... but I'll go.
choices.reason: Admitted your fear to Elder Bram, and chose to go anyway

choices.text: Maybe it's safer to stay here.
choices.reason: Hesitated in front of Elder Bram

brave.text: Ha! Bravado is a fine cloak, but don't let it blind you. Take these herbs, and talk to Tomas at the east gate before you leave.

honest.text: Courage isn't the absence of fear, child. It's walking anyway. Take these herbs, and talk to Tomas at the east gate before you leave.

stay.text: Hmm. The world will still be there when you're ready. Come back when your heart is set.

after.text: The dark cave to the west... the old miners sealed part of it after hearing strange sounds. Only the brave dare enter. The hill to the north-east has braziers no one has lit in centuries, and a stone pillar rises from the lake to the south-east.

advice.text: Treasure hides where people fear to go or forget to look: cliffs, hilltops, behind houses, deep in the woods. And remember, who you become out there matters more than what you carry back.
